Charity Event

Richard Moody’s Holiday Toy/Food Donation Event A Drive Thru 2020

Sun, Dec 13, 2020 · 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM · Hallie Q Brown Community Center

When
Sun, Dec 13, 2020 · 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM
Where
Hallie Q Brown Community Center
270 N Kent Street, St Paul, MN
More: Holiday Charity Party

The need for Hallie Q Brown Community Center this year is greater than ever. I’m calling on all my friends to give one more time this year to help the people in need that depend on the Q.

As you know every year I host the Annual Holiday Party. This year would have been my 30th year. I am going to postpone the party and invite you to a drive-thru.

Just like other years you are invited to bring toys/gift cards for tots and teens. There is also a massive need for food. If you just want to donate cash/checks Hallie Q Brown will gladly take these.

I will be dressed as Moody Santa and ready to thank you for your donation and ready to have our picture taken together.
We will also have until we run out…

  • Hot apple cider
  • Hot chocolate
  • Xmas cookie (wrapped)

WHY:
Hallie Q Brown Community Center. Bring an unwrapped toy for children and teens of all ages. Gifts for teens because they are usually forgotten. All gifts received will be donated to the their holiday program.

WHEN:
Sunday, December 13th
1:00 p.m.—4:00 p.m.

WHERE:
270 N Kent Street
St Paul, MN 55102 United States
+ Google Map

Can’t make it 1pm – 4pm?  

  1. Drop off at my house
  2. Drop off at Hallie Q Brown Monday or Tuesday.
  3. Shop online using the Amazon Wish List
    If you can purchase from Amazon directly you can select from their Amazon Wishlist, where donors may purchase pre-approved gifts and have them sent directly to HQB: Amazon link… https://a.co/dSHdPMS

Thank you,

Richard Moody
